novelty_only (beta=0, nu=0.75, uniform-substitution rule) passes hapax (20/20) but fails H1/H2/units (0/20 each) -- the uniform substitution rule specifically injects the damaging randomness
baseline Naibbe already passes H1/H2/units/order (20/20 each)
not_done_before_registration: No frequency-weighted novelty stream generated or scored
No parameter selected from any transformed outcome

claim: Replacing boundary-state-null's uniform-substitution novelty rule with a frequency-weighted substitution rule (drawn from the replicate's own running atom-unigram distribution, never Voynich's) preserves entropy/unit-scale while still opening vocabulary, passing all six frozen criteria in at least 16 of 20 primary replicates.
base_mechanism: identical to methods/boundary-state-null-preregistration.md: Naibbe cipher (voynich-units commit 956a7c4fc39981f4d116fa3f4edfccce6d065571) + identical boundary-coupling rule (beta, target_initials=[o,q,C,S], target(last)=target_initials[index(last) mod 4]). Only the novelty-injection rule changes.

representation.roundtrip_required: collapse(expand(atom)) == atom for every atomic_alphabet symbol

boundary_coupling.note: unchanged from boundary-state-null; not re-tested as a sensitivity here since it was already validated to preserve entropy/units alone (edge_only result)

frequency_novelty_injection.eligibility: candidate already emitted and atomic length at least 2
frequency_novelty_injection.replacement_distribution: empirical unigram frequency of atoms emitted so far in THIS replicate (running count over the output stream generated up to the current token, not Voynich, not the input plaintext, not a precomputed table)
frequency_novelty_injection.mutation: exhaustive search, identical structure to boundary-state-null's original: iterate every non-initial position in a random-but-seeded order; at each position, iterate all 25 alternative atoms in descending running-frequency order (ties broken by seeded RNG) rather than the original's fixed cyclic order; accept the first unseen type found. This guarantees an unseen variant is found whenever one exists, matching the original design's guarantee exactly, so any difference in outcome vs. the uniform-substitution rule is attributable to which atom is tried, not how hard the search tries (self-review caught and fixed a bounded-random-search confound in the first draft; see logs/2026-09-20-claude-frequency-novelty-selfreview.md).
frequency_novelty_injection.cold_start: before 5 tokens have been emitted, use the original's fixed cyclic order instead of frequency order (no meaningful running distribution exists yet)
frequency_novelty_injection.fallback: retain the boundary-coupled candidate unmutated if no unseen variant exists across the full search (all non-initial positions x all 25 alternatives) -- same condition as the original design

baseline.note: identical to boundary-state-null's baseline; not rerun, values reused by reference

edge_only.note: identical to boundary-state-null's edge_only; not rerun, values reused by reference

configurations.pilot_calibration_rule: nu chosen by a self-consistency-only pilot (3 seeds, frequency_novelty_only config, beta=0) targeting hapax_share_of_types in [0.65, 0.75] -- a band, not Voynich's exact 0.697 point estimate, and never checked against H1/H2/units/edge/order during calibration. Pilot swept nu in {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.45, 0.6, 0.75}: 0.3+ overshoots (74.6%+), 0.15 undershoots (64.7%, just below floor), 0.2 lands in-band (mean 68.5% across 3 seeds). Frozen: nu=0.2. Full pilot log in logs/2026-09-20-claude-frequency-novelty-selfreview.md.

boundary.note: expected to replicate edge_only's existing 20/20 pass since the coupling rule is unchanged; verified again here as a matched control anyway, not assumed

entropy_preservation_diagnostic.not_a_manipulation_check: this is reported for interpretation, not used in the PASS/FAIL/INVALID verdict rule
entropy_preservation_diagnostic.compares: primary configuration's mean H1/H2/bpe_k64_gap against boundary-state-null's old novelty_only and primary values, to quantify whether the frequency-weighted rule actually reduces entropy damage relative to the uniform rule

primary_verdict.pass: Both manipulation checks succeed and at least 16 of 20 primary replicates pass all six criteria
primary_verdict.fail: Both manipulation checks succeed and fewer than 16 of 20 primary replicates pass all six criteria
